note: Only clone/pull have been battle-tested against tad-engine. We never push local .tad/ changes upstream by design, but the command path itself is unverified.

title: tad-engine v1.0.0 and v1.0.1 have no dist/vX.Y.Z tag
note: The dist-tagging fix only applies going forward; those two releases predate it and stay reachable only via the moving dist branch.

title: render.py determinism has only been verified for dc.py, not render.py itself
note: dc.py was stress-tested at 300k rows on a real multi-core GitHub runner; render.py (both the generic one and this repo's custom one) has not had the same treatment.

title: git-subrepo is a slow-moving third-party dependency
note: Last tagged release July 2024 despite ongoing commits, and 201 open issues at last check. A standing risk to monitor, not an active problem.

title: Propagate the RFC-like style to other repos
note: software-engineering-canon and git-rhizoid.github.io still render with their own older presentation (software-engineering-canon has its own local render.py with bold labels; git-rhizoid.github.io pulled the engine before this change). Each needs its own git subrepo pull plus, for software-engineering-canon, the same bold-to-definition-list edit applied to its local render.py by hand.

title: No test coverage for render.py's exact markdown output
note: dc.py has a real test suite; render.py does not - the definition-list change was verified with python-markdown's def_list extension as an approximation of kramdown, and against a real Pages build, but nothing catches a future regression automatically.
